title: The captions layer walk finds the caption size in the panel again
goal: A walk that checks captions are one layer, picked and sized like any other, now stops at its first panel check: with the captions layer picked it finds no text size control in the panel at all. Either the panel stopped showing the captions' size when they are picked, or the walk is looking in the wrong place; find out which and make the walk pass.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-28 (runner of a-walk-s-command-z-undoes-what-it-says-or-the-wa): `Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/captions-are-one-layer-walk.json --no-build` -> '[10 action] captions: one layer picked, box (128.0, 626.4, 1024.0, 93.6), 10 captions filling it at 36 pt' then '[11 expect] FAILED: no menu called "Size" is in the panel to read; the ones that are: none'. Same failure on three runs. Last touched by 6aa4ed87 (Captions only when you ask for them), which swapped the walk to captionsWriteQuietly. Not caused by the Command Z change: step 11 comes before any undo, and the walk's Command Z steps (30, 31) are now shortcut Undo steps.
acceptance: With the Captions layer picked, the panel shows its text size, or the walk reads it where the panel now shows it

log.note: triage 2026-09-29: retagged video-cutting -> video-audio: captions belong to video-audio

Cause: the walk, not the app. 136d05b1 (2026-09-28) opens a recording in View mode, which has no panel by design; this walk predates it and was not updated, so after picking Captions it looked for Size in a panel that was not on screen ('the ones that are: none'). Fix: Command 2 after openSampleTalk, as captions-and-export-for-a-range-walk does. Walk now passes 36/36 at Next defaults with no flags; the picture after picking shows the full Captions panel in Edit mode. Searched every sweep and slice log for the same 'no menu ... none' failure: only this walk. Scripts/test.sh green (10570 tests). No audit: nothing the user sees changed.

The walk was reading a panel that View mode does not show: recordings open in View mode since 136d05b1. The walk now presses Command 2 after opening the sample. captions-are-one-layer-walk passes 36/36 at Next defaults (no flags) and reads Size 36 px, then 64 px, with Captions picked. Scripts/test.sh green. Commit aa443cb8.
